answer: A work bond turns identity into a cost. To join the market, each agent stakes tokens and completes a small verifiable task whose difficulty rises by a fixed delta each round. The stake sits in escrow and is slashed for bad behavior, so one operator spinning up a nebula of fake identities must fund every clone — Sybil attacks become expensive, not free. This is no hollow promise: reputation is earned through locked value and proven work, not claimed with a fresh keypair.
